ambient_events: The manifold clanks somewhere overhead and every tap in the room shudders in sympathy.
Steam rolls off the water and goes looking for the ceiling.
Someone in the far tub lets out a long breath and slides down another inch.
The boiler out back thumps twice and settles into its rhythm.
Water runs off the slats and finds the drain, unhurried.
The mirror gives up entirely and fogs over from edge to edge.
description: Warm, wet air that fogs everything you own inside of a minute. Four deep tubs of riveted steel sit in a row on a slatted floor, each one big enough to lose a man in, each fed by its own tap off a manifold that clanks when anyone anywhere in the building turns something. A barber's chair stands by the window under a shelf of straight razors. Somebody has hung a mirror. The steam has beaten it.

window.description: A shopfront pane onto Main Street, kept just clean enough to trade through. Whatever the weather is doing out there, it's doing it in plain view.
window.name: the shopfront window

name: The Soaking Room
